name: Beatmend
description: Match the rhythm of an ally's pulse with a steady flow of qi and carry it into a deep cut to speed its closing.

name: Tidal Warmth
description: Send a slow wave of warmth from the palms through an ally's strained back until the knotted muscles loosen.

name: Vital Probe
description: Send a fine thread of qi into an ally's chest to trace the strength of the heart and the depth of the breath.

name: Springing Fist
description: Uncoil the legs and drive a fist up and forward on a spring of vitality to jolt the target's jaw.

name: Purging Breath
description: Breathe slowly over an ally who is feverish from a mild toxin and draw the sickly heat out through the palms.

name: Verdant Bulwark
description: Raise a dense shell of vitality along the whole front of the body to absorb a hard blow and spring back.

name: Unflagging Touch
description: Hold a palm to an ally's side and feed steady qi to the strained muscles until the cramping stops.

name: Easing Surge
description: Push a quick surge of qi into an ally's bruised ribs to dull the pain and let the breath deepen.

name: Tireless Pulse
description: Beat vitality into an ally's heart in time with its own rhythm so the ally runs on without tiring.

name: Lithe Leap
description: Spring sideways on a flick of vitality in the thighs to land light and balanced out of reach.

name: Thrumming Palm
description: Strike with the open palm and let a thrumming pulse of vitality run on into the target's body.

name: Fevercool
description: Draw the burning fever from an ally's blood with cool qi and carry the sickly heat out through the hands.

name: Deep Knit
description: Reach beneath the skin with threaded qi to rejoin a torn muscle of an ally from the inside.

name: Soothing Breath
description: Breathe qi into an ally's lungs to soften a hard cough and open the chest after smoke or dust.

name: Tender Closing
description: Draw the lips of an ally's open cut together with two fingers while qi seals them from within.

name: Bloodtaint Tasting
description: Brush qi across an ally's skin to feel whether a poison or a taint lies hidden in the blood.

name: Stalwart Surge
description: Lift an ally's resistance with a surge of vitality so the body shrugs off a creeping ache or chill.

name: Brisk Palm
description: Slap the open palm hard against the target's guard arm with vitality bursting at the point of contact.

name: Pure Shell
description: Spread a faint clean shimmer of qi before the face and chest to turn aside a puff of foul dust.

name: Purifying Draw
description: Press the lips of a bite or sting and draw the poison out through the skin into the user's palm.

name: Clean Tide
description: Wash an ally's blood of a lingering taint by driving clean qi through the veins in slow waves.

name: Bonewarm
description: Set a hand over an ally's cracked bone and weave vitality along the break until the ache dulls.

name: Muscle Renewal
description: Pour fresh vitality into an ally's torn muscle so the fibres bind and the limb regains its strength.

name: Marrow Glow
description: Send heat deep into an ally's long bones to ease the cold ache of an old break.

name: Vigor Wave
description: Send a wave of vitality through the allies nearby so each draws a deeper breath and stands taller.

name: Jolting Palm
description: Thrust the palm at the target's breastbone and release a hard jolt of vitality that shakes the heart.

name: Stalling Pulse
description: Tap the target's wrist with a sharp pulse of qi that breaks the rhythm of its breath and halts its swing.

name: Deep Renewal
description: Pour vitality down through skin and muscle to mend the deep wound of an ally from its far edge inward.

name: Needle Surge
description: Compress vitality into a hair-thin needle on one finger and jab it through armour gaps into the target.

name: Hushed Knit
description: Knit a shallow wound of an ally in quiet silence with a thread of qi drawn slow and even.

name: Warmth Press
description: Press warm palms hard against an ally's strained shoulder and drive the stiffness out in a single pulse.

name: Strength Gauge
description: Press a hand to an ally's back and feel how much vitality remains in the body before the next effort.

name: Quickfoot
description: Flood the feet with vitality and dart three quick paces to the side of an oncoming strike.

name: Shielding Pulse
description: Beat a ring of vitality out from the chest so a blow lands against a springing wall of force.

name: Ripening Blow
description: Hold a blow back while vitality gathers in the fist and release it all in one heavy strike.

name: Vein Rinse
description: Rinse an ally's blood of a drug or a sour taint by pushing clean qi through the wrist and out the palm.

name: Crushing Surge
description: Stamp forward and send the whole reserve of vitality up through the legs into a crushing strike.

name: Sapweave
description: Thread flowing sap-warm qi through an ally's gash so the torn edges draw tight and stop weeping.

name: Gentle Torrent
description: Pour a short gentle torrent of qi over an ally's burns to cool the sting and start new skin.

name: Limb Revival
description: Rub qi along an ally's numbed arm until blood and feeling return to the fingers.

name: Sapspeed
description: Quicken the flow of vitality in an ally's legs so the ally keeps pace with a runner for a long stretch.

name: Vessel Reading
description: Trace the vessels of an ally's arm with a thread of qi to find a burst or a blocked flow.

name: Supple Guard
description: Soften the forearm with vitality so a hard strike sinks into it and rebounds without harm.

name: Rinsing Current
description: Send a rinsing current of clean qi through an ally's body to flush out a swallowed poison.

name: Wasting Touch
description: Lay a hand on an ally and draw out a lingering blight that weakens the muscles and dulls the mind.

name: Siphoning Thorn
description: Stab two fingers into the target's flank and pull a thread of its vitality back into the user.

name: Weary Salve
description: Rub warm qi into an ally's aching feet and calves until the long day's weariness drains away.

name: Closing Kiss
description: Brush two fingers lightly along an ally's cut and close it in a single breath of qi.

name: Lasting Warmth
description: Leave a slow-burning warmth in an ally's chest that keeps the limbs supple through a cold night of work.

name: Weakness Reading
description: Press along an ally's ribs and spine to find the places where hidden injury drains strength.

name: Featherfoot
description: Glide forward on soft vitality-light feet to slip beside a charging attacker and out of its path.

name: Palm Surge
description: Drive an open palm forward behind a surge of vitality to push the target off its feet.

name: Humour Drain
description: Draw a sickly swelling's foul fluid out of an ally's limb with a long steady pull of qi.

name: Healing Cascade
description: Let vitality cascade from the shoulder down an ally's wounded arm to close every cut along its length.

name: Supple Turn
description: Roll the shoulder and let a vitality-slick forearm carry a heavy blow away from the body.

name: Hale Touch
description: Touch an ally's brow and temples with warm fingers to ease a pounding head and a sour stomach.

name: Mending Thread
description: Run a bright thread of qi along a long gash of an ally and draw each stitch of flesh together.

name: Ready Vigor
description: Snap a bright burst of vitality into an ally's limbs so a slow reaction becomes a quick one.

name: Hardened Skin
description: Harden the skin over the ribs with a flush of vitality so a cut slides off and leaves a scratch.

name: Ironvein Strike
description: Swing a vitality-packed fist in a short arc into the target's ribs and feel the force carry through.

name: Gasp Trigger
description: Poke a hard pulse of qi under the target's ribs to force a gasp and break its attack.

name: Curse Easing
description: Hold an ally's hands and draw the cold dread of a minor curse out of the body into clean air.

name: Bright Recovery
description: Flood an exhausted ally with warm vitality in one stroke so the ally rises clear-eyed and steady.

name: Ripening Lash
description: Whip a lash of ripe vitality from the fingertips across the target's face and hands to sting it back.
